description: Renders the given HTML in headless Chrome and scans it. Use this for markup you generated or are about to write. Pass base_url when the HTML references relative stylesheets or images that live on a server you can reach; otherwise inline the CSS, since contrast checks depend on computed styles.

base_url.description: Origin to resolve relative URLs against; the HTML is served at this address.

html.description: A complete HTML document or a fragment.

include_passed.description: Also list rules with zero findings, each with status passed or inapplicable and its checked count.

include_review.description: Also return items that need a human decision (not failures).

max_findings_per_rule.description: Cap on findings returned per rule.

name: scan_html
title: Scan an HTML string for WCAG 2.2 AA issues
